text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today to $142.28, continuing a strong four-day rally that has recovered most of the stock's losses from earlier in the week. The move aligns with a steady climb in oil prices — US crude is trading at $89.62 per barrel, up from the lows that triggered the earlier decline — and broader energy sector momentum that's lifting exploration and production companies.

The timing matters: heating oil prices have spiked 59% from last winter, keeping refined product demand elevated heading into the cold months, and there's no sign of weakening energy demand despite shipping cost pressures on retailers elsewhere in the economy. This supports continued strength in both crude and refined products, which underpins companies like ConocoPhillips.
